_meta.name: Viracnon (Southern Catanduanes Bikol, ISO 639-3: bln) SEED lexicon
_meta.status: SEED / STARTING LEXICON ONLY. This is NOT a complete or full dictionary. It must be expanded only from the primary sources listed in README.md.
_meta.normalization: All strings are Unicode NFC. The palatalized lateral is the single code point U+1E3D (ḽ).

confidence_values.CONFIRMED-VIRAC: Attested for the Virac dialect: either marked so in the project brief's seed list, or cited to a Virac-specific primary source in `source`.
confidence_values.COGNATE-PROBABLE: Bikol-wide form, NOT independently confirmed for Virac. Verify against the sources before upgrading.

fields.gloss: English gloss as supplied by the project brief, or (Spanish loanwords) the meaning of the Spanish etymon as noted in `source`; null where none is available
fields.pos: part of speech / category as supplied by the brief
fields.affix_analysis: null = unanalysed lexeme; otherwise {prefixes, root, surface_root, suffixes, reduplication} or {type: multiword, components}
